the partial widths for D D decay of excited charmonia are reduced in nuclear matter, and that the reduction is most pronounced for the χ c states.
the widths of charmonium states with J P C = 1 − −, 0 − + and 1 + − into D D are strongly suppressed in nuclear matter, while those of 2 − + states are enhanced.
the widths of charmonium states in matter are much smaller than naively expected and that the widths of χ states are much larger than those of the ψ states.
